messages:
mike.k: Heads-up: we're planning a small change to how routing policies pick a target (org vs project vs service-account). Main Q: how should quotas and billing attribution work when a service account from Org A routes to Dedicated pool B? cc @anya @jlee
anya: I think default billing attribution should be the service account's project, not the org — infra teams expect per-project quotas. We should offer an override in the console.
jlee: Product prefers org-level quotas for enterprise customers. Suggestion: priority order project override -> org fallback. Console should display the effective owner clearly.
sara: Runtime note: current token payload only includes org_id and project_id; service_account_id is optional. We should make SA explicit in tokens for routing, quota checks, and telemetry.
tom: SRE caution: allowing project-level quotas to bypass org limits could let a project exhaust a shared pool. Need routing-layer cross-checks: if project would exceed org cap, deny or fallback.
mike.k: Agree. Draft policy DSL example — simple prototype to discuss:

```
routing_policy:
  match:
    service_account: "sa-*"
  route_to: dedicated-pool-fast
  quota_accounting: project
  fallback: org
```

Would this cover routing/billing attribution?
anya: Looks good. Add an explicit `billing_entity` field so logs and telemetry can unambiguously show which account was charged.
jlee: Also console UX asks for a "what-if" calculator and an "effective billing entity" column in the route table for rollouts. PM will add to roadmap.
deploy-bot: rollout started: feature/sa-routing-quota @mike.k initiated deployment to staging at 2026-03-18T14:12:03Z :shipit:
sara: For backwards compatibility, if SA is absent fall back to project->org. Also add telemetry tags: `billing_entity_id` and `billing_granularity`.
tom: :thumbsup: We'll implement a gateway-level rate-limit enforcement so routes can't be used to bypass org caps.
mike.k: Next steps (owners): 1) add SA claim to tokens (auth) 2) implement policy DSL + runtime checks (platform/runtime) 3) console mockups + what-if calc (product). ETA? @anya
anya: Auth team expects token change by EOW. Platform prototype in ~2 weeks. Product mockups next sprint. Let's sync Wed for alignment.
